name: r-psychometrics
description: Research-editable item, reliability, EFA and CFA/SEM workflows with native R estimation and verified reporting.

interface.shortDescription: Item, reliability and factor-model analysis in R.
interface.longDescription: Inspect measurement items, estimate reliability, explore factor structure, and fit conventional CFA and basic SEM with explicit model choices, native diagnostics and verified reporting.
defaultPrompt: Inspect these items and estimate reliability for the declared score.
Explore the factor structure of these ordered questionnaire items.
Fit and compare these CFA models with native summaries and psymetrics reports.
